name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – § 5 – Am 48
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 5. Stresses that the unwillingness of the Union and its Member States to decouple their collective security from the United States and NATO is in direct contradiction to the objective of achieving greater European strategic autonomy;
